summary: This is a Doxygen-generated API reference page for the moveit_configs_utils.launches Python namespace in the MoveIt Motion Planning Framework for ROS 2. It lists eight functions that generate launch files for MoveIt robot configurations, each taking a moveit_config argument, and gives their source line numbers and brief descriptions where available. The demo launch function is described as a self-contained demo that includes static virtual joint transforms, robot state publisher, move_group, RViz, optional warehouse database, and ros2_control with controller spawners.
one_line: Doxygen API reference for the moveit_configs_utils.launches namespace, listing functions that generate MoveIt ROS 2 launch files.
key_facts: The page is part of the MoveIt Motion Planning Framework for ROS 2 documentation.
The moveit_configs_utils.launches namespace contains eight functions, each taking a moveit_config argument.
generate_rsp_launch generates a launch file for the robot state publisher (rsp) and is defined at line 23 of launches.py.
generate_moveit_rviz_launch generates a launch file for rviz and is defined at line 47 of launches.py.
generate_setup_assistant_launch generates a launch file for the MoveIt Setup Assistant and is defined at line 77 of launches.py.
generate_static_virtual_joint_tfs_launch is defined at line 92 of launches.py.
generate_spawn_controllers_launch is defined at line 118 of launches.py.
generate_warehouse_db_launch generates a launch file for the warehouse database and is defined at line 135 of launches.py.
generate_move_group_launch is defined at line 189 of launches.py.
generate_demo_launch launches a self-contained demo and is defined at line 252 of launches.py.
The generate_demo_launch demo includes static_virtual_joint_tfs, robot_state_publisher, move_group, moveit_rviz, warehouse_db (optional), and ros2_control_node with controller spawners.
